name: lookup_obd2_code
description: Retrieves official OEM definition, triggering criteria, probable causes, and freeze-frame parameters for an OBD-II diagnostic trouble code (e.g., P0300, P0A0C, C1A12).

dtc_code.description: The standardized 5-character alphanumeric trouble code, e.g. 'P0300', 'P0A0C', 'C1A12'.

name: get_torque_spec
description: Returns authorized factory torque specifications, fastener size, and thread treatment for vehicle chassis, engine, and electrical bolts.

component_name.description: Component or fastener name, e.g., 'spark plug', 'wheel lug nuts', 'PDU ground bolt'.

name: get_wiring_and_pinout
description: Fetches connector IDs, pin assignments, operating voltages, and resistance tolerances for sensor and actuator circuits.

circuit_name.description: Name of circuit or sensor, e.g., 'HVIL connector PDU-X02', 'O2 Sensor', 'Resolver Sin/Cos'.

name: verify_hv_safety_protocol
description: Validates mandatory high-voltage safety isolation steps and PPE requirements prior to servicing EV battery, inverter, or charger components.

operation.description: Type of maintenance or diagnostic operation being planned, e.g., 'BMS inspection', 'inverter swap'.
